card.name: Inside capitalized EMBRYO-FETAL headings
card.fires_on: The final piece of an all-caps word such as EMBRY-O in EMBRYO-FETAL TOXICITY, mostly in boxed warning headings. It also fires on the ION ending of TRANSFUSION in all-caps text.

modes.label: EMBRYO-FETAL heading
modes.description: The O ending EMBRY in the capitalized boxed warning title EMBRYO-FETAL TOXICITY.

modes.label: Other all-caps words
modes.description: The end of a long capitalized word in headings or lists, such as TRANSFUSION or EMBRYOLOGY.
